transcript.text: What is the main thing the hobs is doing wrong?
one of the rings on the hob won't heat up. the rear right one, the others are fine
The type of hob changes what to check. Is it an induction hob (only works with magnetic pans), a ceramic hob (smooth glass that glows red), a solid-plate hob, or gas?
it's a ceramic one, smooth glass top with touch controls. Zanussi

[Heading: That zone's element or its control]
Thanks for confirming that detail about your Zanussi ceramic hob. One zone failing to heat is typically caused by either the heating element or its control switch. This issue requires an appliance engineer to test safely, so I am not recommending you replace any parts yourself. Please refer to the image shown below for further guidance.
[Helpful to see: image "About the hob heating parts" — When a hob zone won't heat or heats unevenly, the parts involved are the heating element/zone, the temperature sensor and the control board — and on an induction hob, the pan itself must be suitable. This reference shows where they sit and the safe checks (use the right pan, keep the surface clean, try a reset). Replacing hob parts is a job for a qualified engineer.]
